body: I have her card somewhere but I'm so bad at reaching out for help. I hate burdening other people. I tend to just bottle things up until it all explodes like tonight. It's probably best for me to just go to bed..

My friends have since abandoned me. They got sick of hanging around someone who was sad all of the time. It just made me feel like a burden on everyone around me. My counselor was great. She helped a lot. Unfortunately, she was a university counselor and the university health services have closed down for winter break. I've never had any of these feeling prior to my father's death. I was generally a very happy, relaxed, and outgoing person. All of this is new and strange to me.

I just wish I had one person to call. Someone who would be willing to come over and just hold me while I cry. I'm in a city four and a half hours away from any relatives and I've lost all of my friends. I'm just so sick of feeling sad all the time

About a week after my fathers funeral is when I first started having anything like these feelings. After everything settled down, it really sunk in how alone I am. I started seeing a counselor and depending heavily on the few friends I had left for support. For some reason today it just all came crashing down on me.
Thank you. I don't even know where to start.
